title: Titan Zero Cleaning Business Tools Programme

steps.text: Create one authoritative registry for every existing and future tool, covering purpose, category, inputs, outputs, launch surface, supported roles, permissions, company_id scope, autonomy limits, AI/provider requirements, costs, offline capability and dependencies.
Classify all recovered generic tool families by cleaning-business relevance and role fit without removing generic capability.
Add a validated registry loader and tests so malformed, cross-company or authority-ambiguous tool definitions fail closed.
Persist this 30-pass programme and pass state inside Titan Zero so each future pass can determine the next required work from the ZIP itself.
Give every tool common start, progress, stop, cancel, retry, timeout, success, failure, recovery, history and diagnostics behaviour.
Preserve specialist rich interfaces while removing inconsistent duplicate runtime wrappers.
Add standard tool-run receipts with provider, model, cost route, authority decision and result status.
Certify that tool identity never grants execution authority.
Create a common context envelope for company, customer, property, quote, booking, job, worker, document, webpage, photo, selected text and workflow context.
Normalize all legacy tenant fields immediately to company_id before tool use.
Add context minimisation so tools receive only the information needed for the task.
Add provenance and freshness markers to tool context.
Classify tools by read-only, recommendation, drafting, data modification, communication, financial and operational effects.
Enforce Titan autonomy and device-first/BYO cost rules at execution time.
Create structured tool-run memory so results become reusable business evidence.
Add budget, entitlement and provider fallback receipts.
Upgrade Write, Rewrite and Grammar with cleaning-specific modes for quotes, scopes, job notes, customer messages, complaints, policies and staff instructions.
Specialise Translate for multilingual customers and workers while retaining source text and provenance.
Create cleaning communication templates for bookings, arrival, delays, access, completion, payment and follow-up.
Add a complaint/service-recovery writing mode grounded in actual job evidence.
Turn Search into cleaning research modes for products, equipment, surfaces, suppliers, procedures, regulations and business opportunities.
Expand ChatPDF/document tools for SOPs, SDS, manuals, tenders, contracts, training manuals and regulatory material.
Extract actionable tasks, warnings, requirements and citations from documents without replacing source authority.
Keep external research clearly separated from private company knowledge.
Specialise image generation/editing for before-and-after content, customer evidence, training and marketing.
Specialise video generation for procedures, onboarding, marketing and service explanations.
Use audio-to-text for calls, voice notes, worker reports and inspection dictation.
Add privacy and permission gates before customer/job media is repurposed.
Create a Cleaning Enquiry Analyser for calls, emails, chats and voice notes.
Create Visual Estimating assistance for rooms, surfaces, visible condition, likely complexity and missing information.
Distinguish visual observations from uncertain inference.
Generate the next best clarification questions before quoting.
Build a structured estimator using service type, property, rooms, bathrooms, condition, surfaces, frequency, extras, access, labour, travel, equipment and pricing policy.
Create a Scope-of-Work Builder from enquiry and inspection evidence.
Add a Quote Challenge and Margin Checker for missed work, scope creep, unrealistic labour and forgotten costs.
Preserve human approval for price commitments unless explicit authority exists.
Create persistent company-scoped property cleaning profiles.
Build a Surface Intelligence tool for common cleaning materials and contraindications.
Build a Stain and Soil Investigation tool with guided uncertainty reduction.
Attach historical work, recurring problems and customer requirements to the property profile.
Create a Chemical/Product Assistant grounded in company-approved products and authoritative SDS/product data.
Expose dilution, dwell time, PPE, restrictions and incompatibilities only from approved sources.
Create an Equipment Assistant for selection, setup, maintenance and troubleshooting.
Prevent model-generated safety instructions from overriding authoritative product information.
Convert accepted scope into labour, sequencing, workers, equipment, products, access instructions and dependencies.
Generate dynamic checklists based on the actual job rather than one static template.
Create service-specific plans for domestic, commercial, bond/end-of-lease, hotel, periodic and specialist cleaning.
Carry completion criteria and evidence requirements into field execution.
Create a Go-focused job assistant that understands the active job.
Answer what-next, method, product, customer-requirement and reporting questions from approved context.
Create guided handling for access problems, damage, unsafe conditions, unexpected stains, equipment failures and extra-work requests.
Route protected or high-risk exceptions to appropriate human review.
Create a Smart Completion tool comparing scope, checklist, evidence and unresolved issues.
Create Visual Site Inspection assistance for rooms, surfaces, soil, access issues and hazards.
Create matched Before/After evidence packages by area and task.
Create a pre-existing damage recorder with timestamped job/property linkage.
Build a Visual QA Inspector that uses scope, checklist, photos and exceptions.
Require supervisor review where visual evidence is uncertain rather than issuing unsupported pass/fail claims.
Generate completion, inspection, incident and customer evidence reports.
Create quality trend signals for repeated missed work and rework.
Build a structured worker skills matrix for service types, surfaces, chemicals, machinery and procedures.
Match workers to jobs using skills, location, availability, complexity and training.
Create a cleaning training assistant from approved Titan knowledge and current job context.
Create competency assessment with supervisor-verifiable evidence.
Create a Supervisor Assistant for upcoming risk, incomplete jobs, QA exceptions, complaints and coaching opportunities.
Analyse repeated rework and performance patterns without blindly rewarding speed.
Create targeted coaching recommendations tied to evidence.
Keep disciplinary or employment decisions human-controlled.
Create a Customer Communication Centre for booking, arrival, access, delay, completion and follow-up messages.
Build a Complaint Investigation tool combining scope, history, notes, photos, messages and QA evidence.
Build a Service Recovery Assistant for re-clean, credit/refund consideration and escalation within policy.
Capture customer preferences only where permitted and surface them on future work.
Create lead qualification based on fit, value, urgency, location and complexity with explanations.
Create quote/enquiry follow-up assistance using actual customer context.
Identify legitimate upsell opportunities from property and job context without manufacturing unnecessary work.
Design sensible recurring service programmes from actual property requirements.
Investigate missed calls, unanswered enquiries, expired quotes, cancellations and overdue follow-ups.
Analyse job profitability using estimated versus actual labour, travel, materials, rework and revenue.
Analyse labour efficiency without sacrificing quality.
Connect lost-revenue recovery to the canonical revenue journey where available.
Create route and schedule assistance around geography, worker availability and job windows.
Forecast consumables requirements and potential shortages from scheduled work.
Track equipment availability, utilisation, maintenance and conflicts.
Generate operational recommendations without silently changing schedules or purchases.

passes.title: Business Intake and Process Investigation Crew

steps.text: Create structured business intake for services, customers, workforce, systems, pricing, processes, costs, equipment and suppliers.
Build process discovery from interviews, documents, screen captures and observations.
Map enquiry, quoting, booking, job, QA, invoicing and customer-service flows.
Preserve source evidence for every inferred process finding.
Identify duplicated admin, travel, repeated data entry, waiting, rework, consumable waste and underused assets.
Identify automation opportunities and recommend appropriate Suggest/Assist/Semi-Auto/Auto/Trusted-Auto levels.
Create a prioritised business improvement opportunity map across revenue, labour, quality, environment and admin.
Require explicit approval before operational changes are enacted.
Analyse chemical consumption against service volume and abnormal use.
Analyse water-consuming cleaning processes and reduction opportunities.
Analyse energy/equipment use and consumables/waste.
Generate evidence-based environmental performance reports for company and customers.

passes.title: Safety, SDS, Incident and Jurisdiction Tools

steps.text: Create a Cleaning Hazard Assistant based on job, property, products, equipment and observations.
Create structured SDS intelligence preserving authoritative source data.
Create an Incident Assistant for facts, photos, people and immediate actions without invented conclusions.
Add jurisdiction-aware guidance for Australia, USA, UK, Europe and other supported regions.
Create an integrated cleaning Marketing Studio using writing, image and video capabilities.
Build permission-aware before/after content and case-study generation.
Create local service/location campaign and website service-page assistance.
Connect campaign activity to leads, quotes, bookings and revenue outcomes.
Create governed multi-tool workflows while preserving individual permissions and evidence.
Build enquiry-to-job orchestration from analysis through quote, scope, booking and job plan.
Build job-to-quality orchestration from checklist through evidence, QA and completion.
Build customer lifecycle and business-improvement orchestration chains.
Recommend contextual tools from the current business/job situation instead of requiring manual catalogue browsing.
Detect opportunities and exceptions from permitted signals with evidence.
Create Go camera-first, voice-first and offline-capable field tool entry points.
Allow specialist Workforce Agents to invoke tools through Agent Mesh without identity becoming authority.

passes.title: Owner Command Centre, Discovery and Extensibility

steps.text: Create owner tool command centre, daily investigator, management analysis and decision-comparison tools.
Finish rich cleaning-focused Tool Marketplace with categories, search, favourites, recents, role views, job-aware drawer and tool packs.
Create governed company tool templates/builder with versioning and rollback.
Create sandboxed tool proposal/testing workflow before live deployment.
Create tool outcome ledger, quality metrics, feedback loops, improvement investigation and cost/value intelligence.
Run every-tool functional audit and Zero/Go/Hub/browser cross-surface certification.
Certify company isolation, authority, safety, knowledge provenance, jurisdiction handling and cost controls.
Publish the production Cleaning Tools release, remove superseded donor paths and certify exact reconstruction.
